settings.kicker: Bespoke beds, made in West Yorkshire
settings.text: Have a design in mind? We can create bespoke beds tailored to your size, style and space.

settings.heading: We make your idea
settings.text: Five simple steps, one team, from first message to finished bed.

settings.title: Your idea
settings.text: Send us a photo, drawing, screenshot or a bed you want recreated, or simply describe what you want.

settings.title: We discuss
settings.text: We confirm the dimensions, fabric, colour, headboard, storage and mattress with you, and send a clear quote.

settings.title: We create
settings.text: Your bed is made by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop to the exact specification we agreed.

settings.title: We deliver
settings.text: Our own team delivers it free to your door anywhere on mainland UK.

settings.title: You enjoy
settings.text: The finished bed arrives ready for its new home, backed by our 5-year warranty.

settings.heading: Tell us about your bed
settings.text: The more detail the better: a photo, measurements, the fabric you love. We usually reply within one working day.
settings.list:
Custom sizes
Custom fabrics
Custom colours
Custom headboards
Custom storage
Unique shapes

settings.a: Custom sizes, shapes, fabrics, colours, headboard heights and styles, storage (drawers or gas-lift ottoman), and matching headboards. If you have a photo of a bed you love, send it and we will tell you honestly what is possible.

settings.q: How much does a bespoke bed cost?
settings.a: It depends on the size, design and fabric. Most bespoke beds start from a similar price to the closest bed in our range. Send your idea and we will reply with a clear quote, usually within one working day.

settings.q: How do I send my photos or drawings?
settings.a: Fill in the quote form, then email your images straight after to eaglebedofficial@gmail.com with your name. We will match them to your request.

settings.q: Is delivery free on bespoke beds?
settings.a: Yes. Delivery is free to mainland UK addresses, just like the rest of our range.

settings.heading: Not sure what to choose?
settings.text: Talk to the people who make the beds. We'll help with sizes, fabrics, storage and access, with no pressure.
